sessions.title: Replacing 12K LoC with a 200 LoC Skill
sessions.abstract: How a 12,000-line hand-rolled subsystem was replaced by a 200-line agent skill, what broke along the way, and the decision framework for when this trade is worth making.

sessions.title: Every API Is a Tool for Agents
sessions.abstract: Treating every existing API surface as an agent tool: the adapter patterns, the auth problems, and what breaks at scale when agents call APIs designed for humans.

sessions.title: Beyond Code Coverage: Functionality Testing with Playwright
sessions.abstract: Coverage numbers say a line ran, not that a feature works. A practical tour of functionality-level browser testing and what it catches that unit tests never will.

sessions.title: Agents Don't Do Standups: Building the Post-Engineer Engineering Org
sessions.abstract: What team structure, rituals, and career ladders look like when a meaningful share of the work is done by agents rather than people.

sessions.title: How Building with AI Can Double the Throughput of Your Engineering Team
sessions.abstract: Measured throughput changes across a large engineering org after AI tooling rollout — what moved, what didn't, and which measurements were misleading.

sessions.title: Most Enterprise Agentic Projects Are Doomed — Here's Why
sessions.abstract: A post-mortem across enterprise agent deployments: the budgeting, governance, and ROI-modelling mistakes that sink them before the technology ever gets a chance.

sessions.title: Scaling Reinforcement Learning: Lessons from Trillion-Token Deployments at Fortune 500s
sessions.abstract: Cost structure, procurement realities, and measured returns of trillion-token RL deployments inside large regulated enterprises.
